mass.curb_mass.description: Curb mass (manufacturer curb weight), 2024 Sport Touring hatchback 6MT

candidates.locator: DIMENSIONS table, row 'Curb weight – MT/CVT (kg)', SPORT TOURING column
candidates.notes: Canadian figure for exactly the target trim and gearbox. Columns are SPORT then SPORT TOURING; Sport is CVT-only in Canada for 2024 (NA for MT). The resolver selects the Canadian record.

candidates.locator: Exterior Measurements table, row 'Curb Weight (6MT/CVT)', Sport Touring column
candidates.evidence: Curb Weight (6MT/CVT) NA / 2877 lbs 2932 lbs / 2956 lbs NA / 3053 lbs 3036 lbs / 3102 lbs
candidates.notes: US figure for the same trim/gearbox; 3036 lb = 1377.1 kg, about 5 kg below the Canadian 1382 kg. The difference is small (0.4 %) and may come from Canadian-market equipment or rounding/definition differences; both are kept, the Canadian value is the target-market value.

mass.front_fraction.description: Static front-axle share of curb mass

candidates.locator: Exterior Measurements table, row 'Weight Distribution (front/rear, 6MT)', Sport Touring column (4th)
candidates.notes: Published to whole percent, so the true value lies in about 0.585-0.595. The two printed values sit in the Sport (60/40) and Sport Touring (59/41) columns; LX and EX-L cells are empty (no 6MT), checked in raw HTML. US-market figure; no Canadian distribution figure found (Honda Canada spec release lists none). Same trim/gearbox/body/engine, so mechanically applicable to the Canadian car (CA curb mass differs by ~5 kg).
Same value in both Canadian trim columns.

candidates.locator: EPA Mileage Ratings / Fuel table, row 'Fuel Tank Capacity'
candidates.evidence: Fuel Tank Capacity 12.39 gal 12.39 gal 12.39 gal 12.39 gal
candidates.notes: 12.39 US gal = 46.9 L; Canada prints 46 L. Same tank, different rounding/unit convention (not a conflict beyond rounding: 46 L as printed vs 46.9 L).
